hypothesis: Current-season receiver performance conditional on opposing man/zone usage improves receiving-yards means versus the same-player current-season average. Other CSV families enter a private covariate ledger for separately tested extensions, not automatic invented multipliers.
requirements: Exact name/team/position, unambiguous rows and current season
Current-season source clocks known before target kickoff and export age<=8days
Same player game and overall-route counts in receiving and coverage tables
Man and zone route counts both positive; combined count not above overall routes
Opponent coverage shares sum to100 within1percentage point; normalize rounding only
Current eligibility remains a separate mandatory recommendation gate
No derived win probability, confidence boost, ROI claim or automatic model promotion
baselines: exact production Champion mean at capture
same-player current-season receiving yards per game
real matched posted line only when available before kickoff

evaluation.acceptance: At least1yard paired MAE reduction versus Champion and current-season average; upper95% confidence bound below0 for both game/player clustered differences; no material RMSE worsening. No repeated holdout tuning.

privacy: Inputs and per-player covariates/predictions remain under ignored FantasyPoints/model_inputs. No retrospective backfill from current season-total exports.
next_extensions: Pre-register opportunity/TD/game-line models separately once source units, point-in-time coverage and outcomes support fitting.
